status: V3 remains visually rejected: broad rectangular patches and weakly perceived motion. V4 replaces the value-noise shader with original spectral normal textures and native time-driven panning. Integration and motion acceptance are pending.

water.time_source: Explicit native MaterialExpressionTime: ignore_pause=false, override_period=false. Native Panner uses fractional time offsets for precision.
water.filter_policy: Normal-map compression, wrapping UVs, regular mips, texture-group filtering and no negative view mip bias. No pixel-footprint hard cutoff or lattice noise.
water.color_variation: None. Base color and volume coefficients are uniform; surface movement comes from displaced spectral normals.
water.level_policy: Keep all source transforms, mesh geometry, collision and datum heights. Change only component material overrides.

sky.sun_shadow_policy: Fixed deep overcast uses directional fill without cast shadows. The 6200 m capture pair confirms that cast shadows caused the pale dry-shore streaks and hard route patches. Keep captured sky light and existing ambient occlusion.
sky.weather_policy: Fixed artistic overcast. This is not a weather observation or calibrated daylight model.

sources.use: Opaque Single Layer Water material and four volume inputs. Local header defines coefficient units as 1/cm.
Movable sky light, captured scene, resolution and capture cost.
Opaque unlit sky material with Is Sky. The fixed dome replaces the blue atmosphere in this map.
Bounded HLSL custom nodes. Custom nodes can prevent constant folding; no claim of measured GPU cost.
Native Panner coordinates and explicit Time input. Fractional pan offsets preserve precision during long runs.
Normal-map texture settings, mip generation and wrapping filters.

capture_plan.status: V1-V3 remain failed visual variants. V4 requires actual fixed-camera 0.5-2 second motion captures and representative GPU measurement by root.
capture_plan.v1_findings: Water shows regular parallel reflection bands near the camera and dark alias patterns at distance. The fixed cloudy sky is plausible in these stills; its settings stay unchanged.
capture_plan.v2_findings: Stripes are absent but water is nearly uniform at bicycle viewing distances. The conservative pixel-footprint filter and small weak noise are the likely causes. Global reflections remain disabled; V3 reuses the noise for mild base-color, scattering and roughness variation.
capture_plan.v3_findings: Play images show pattern changes, but broad rectangular patches are visible and the user cannot perceive convincing water movement. Root confirms the ocean is a four-vertex quad; nearshore polygon edges can come from the underlying terrain/refraction. Shore geometry is owned by root.
